metadata.title: Content Studio
host.previewExpired: This temporary preview expired, was evicted, or the local server restarted. Refresh it from the workbench. Your open document remains in the workbench.
workbench.title: Page editor
workbench.subtitle: Project file · Puck layout · language catalogs · context
workbench.invalidDrafts: Invalid field drafts block preview and export: {fields}
workbench.replaceDescription: Unsaved layout, catalog or context edits will be replaced. Published content remains unchanged.
workbench.documentDraft: Unapplied JSON draft. Canvas shows the last applied document.
workbench.documentCurrent: Current raw document. Variables and bindings are preserved.
workbench.canvasChanged: The canvas changed after this JSON draft began. Applying replaces the canvas session.
workbench.inputNotApplied: Unapplied input. The viewer shows the current working copy.
workbench.contextDraft: Unapplied context draft. Canvas uses the last applied context.
workbench.contextCurrent: Non-copy context is saved inside the complete project file.
workbench.previewUnconfigured: This host has not configured page preview.
workbench.previewBlocked: Apply drafts and fix errors before requesting a preview. Any visible frame is a previous snapshot.
workbench.previewStale: Previous preview snapshot. Refresh to see current content or theme.
workbench.previewIdle: Request a preview of the current valid document.
workbench.previewReady: Preview snapshot ready. Temporary previews expire after a few minutes.
workbench.exportFinished: {kind} download started for the submitted snapshot. Any newer changes still need export.
workbench.exportFailed: Download failed. No snapshot was marked as exported.
workbench.fileSaved: Local file saved. Newer edits may still need saving.
workbench.fileDownloaded: Download started. The original file has not been confirmed saved.
workbench.fileFailed: File operation failed. Your current work is preserved.
workbench.publicationCurrent: The submitted languages match the published snapshot.
workbench.publicationDirty: There are changes not published to the selected target.
workbench.sharedKeyNotice: Editing a shared key updates every referencing field.
workbench.referencedKey: Referenced keys must be unbound before deletion.
workbench.keyHelp: Use a dot path, or a JSON string array for literal dots.
workbench.unbindVariable: Use current value as direct value
workbench.unbindWarning: Direct values no longer follow language changes.
workbench.publishLoaded: Project retrieved. Confirm replacement if prompted; Save As creates a local working file.
workbench.publishSucceeded: Snapshot published. Local file save status is separate.
workbench.publishConflict: The target changed. Inspect or open its latest version before publishing again.
workbench.publishNotFound: No content exists at this target.
workbench.publishInvalid: Choose a target and fix the reported publication issues.
workbench.publishFailed: The target operation failed. Your current work is preserved.
workbench.publishConfirmBody: This updates the selected target. Local file saving remains a separate action.
workbench.pendingDrafts: Apply or repair visible JSON drafts before saving or publishing.
workbench.publishAttached: Target version linked. Your current project is preserved; Publish will replace the target content.
workbench.previewEmptyHelp: Add text, media or another visible element. Empty layout containers do not produce a page preview.
workspace.name: Studio
workspace.chrome.pageFailed: This page could not be opened. Navigation is still available.
workspace.chrome.theme.label: Appearance
workspace.pages.overview.title: Overview
workspace.pages.overview.description: Studio shell, registered pages and local editing tools.
workspace.pages.demo.title: Demo
workspace.pages.demo.description: A custom resource page with a record table, editable fields and a card preview.
workspace.pages.pages.title: Pages
workspace.pages.pages.description: Create, open and publish pages using the Demo memory adapter.
workspace.overview.title: Studio structure
workspace.overview.body: The shell provides navigation and page containers. Each registered React page owns its content, state and data connections. No database is selected by the shell.
workspace.overview.demoBody: Select an in-memory record, edit its fields and inspect the card preview. This page shows where application-specific tools belong.
workspace.overview.editorBody: Create an independent page or edit a page associated with a Demo item. The resource page composes file operations, publication and Puck editing.
workspace.demo.notice: Demo only. Items, published pages and images stay in this module’s browser memory. Refreshing resets them. No SQL or object storage is connected.
workspace.demo.extensionBody: Register a resource entry and implement its pages with Next routes. Its code defines record fields, preview components and the publication workflow. Inject image and record adapters to connect real services.
workspace.demo.editorBody: Pages are independent resources. The Demo composes the reusable editor, local file controls and injected publication operations; each resource defines its own association rules.
workspace.demo.fields.title: Title
workspace.demo.editNotice: Fields are a local draft. Apply changes to update the record in memory.
workspace.demo.invalidFields: Enter a title and valid field values before applying changes.
workspace.demo.upload.title: Create record
workspace.demo.upload.description: Publish validates the draft, resolves an optional image through the image adapter, then creates the record through the record adapter. This demo uses Blob URLs and shared memory.
workspace.demo.upload.urlHelp: Use an existing HTTP(S) image URL, a path on this host, or a Blob URL from this demo. URL mode does not upload the image.
workspace.demo.upload.fileHelp: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to {maxMiB} MiB. Choosing a file only creates a local preview.
workspace.demo.upload.invalidImage: Choose a supported image within the size limit.
workspace.demo.upload.idle: Draft only. Publish runs the configured workflow.
workspace.demo.upload.invalid: Check the title, image URL and file requirements. No record was created.
workspace.demo.upload.failures.image: The image step failed. Your draft is preserved.
workspace.demo.upload.failures.record: The record step failed. Your draft and completed image step are retained for retry.
workspace.demo.pages.title: Pages
workspace.demo.pages.description: Published pages in this Demo session. A page can be independent or associated with one item.
workspace.demo.pages.name: Page name
workspace.demo.pages.empty: No pages have been published in this session.
workspace.demo.pages.importHelp: JSON import replaces the working content, not this Page ID or item association. The content is not published until you choose Publish.
workspace.demo.pages.publicationHelp: Publish commits the page snapshot and any pending item association together in memory. Save and Save As only write a local file.
workspace.demo.pages.fileHelp: Open or replace JSON, edit layout and catalogs, and save local files. New document clears the working content while keeping this resource identity.
workspace.demo.pages.load.missing: This page or item is unavailable in the current Demo session. A refresh resets memory. Return to Pages or Items to open a current resource.
workspace.demo.pages.load.failed: The page could not be opened. Return to Pages and try again.
workspace.demo.pages.status.idle: Changes stay in the working session until Publish.
workspace.demo.pages.status.published: Snapshot published to Demo memory. Local file save status is separate.
workspace.demo.pages.status.unlinked: Item association removed. The published page and current working content are preserved.
workspace.demo.pages.status.conflict: The page or item association changed. Return to Pages and reopen its current version before publishing.
workspace.demo.pages.status.failed: The operation failed. Your working content is preserved.
workspace.demo.pages.status.invalid: Check the page name, visible drafts and content validation issues.
workspace.demo.pages.binding.title: Item association
workspace.demo.pages.binding.help: A page and an item can each have at most one association in this Demo. Unbind before choosing another item. Independent publication is allowed.
workspace.demo.pages.binding.confirmBody: This immediately removes the published association. It does not delete the page or discard your working content.
workspace.demo.pages.leave.title: Leave this editing session?
workspace.demo.pages.leave.description: Unpublished page content, name or pending association may be lost. Local files and published pages are unchanged.
workspace.demo.pages.controls.title: Page controls
workspace.demo.pages.editing.limitation: Experimental interactive editor. Basic editing is available, but interaction quality is not production-ready. Use JSON editing and the Viewer for the supported workflow.
workspace.demo.pages.editing.pending: Unapplied JSON is kept separately. This canvas edits the working copy; applying a conflicting source draft will require a reset.
workspace.demo.pages.previewTheme.label: Preview theme
workspace.demo.recordEditing.status.conf: The record changed. Reopen the latest version before saving.
workspace.demo.recordEditing.status.not-: This record is no longer available.
workspace.demo.recordEditing.status.unav: Changes could not be saved. Your draft is kept; try again.
workspace.demo.recordEditing.leave.title: Discard record changes?
workspace.demo.recordEditing.leave.descr: Unsaved field edits will be discarded. A pending write may already have reached the adapter.
workspace.demo.recordEditing.newerDraft: Submitted changes were saved. Newer edits still need applying.
jsonEditor.title: JSON source
jsonEditor.resetDescription: This replaces the selected JSON draft with the current working section. Other drafts are kept.
jsonEditor.draft: Unapplied JSON. The viewer shows the working copy.
jsonEditor.conflict: This section changed elsewhere. Your draft is kept; reset it to edit the current version.

status.notFound.title: Page not found
status.notFound.description: The page you requested could not be found.
status.error.title: This page could not load
status.error.description: Something interrupted this page. Try again or return to the homepage.
